literal: The world that which embraces [is] wisdom; blooming and closing that which is without [is] knowledge.
translation: Wisdom is that which embraces the world. True knowledge is that which neither blooms nor closes.
modern: உலகத்தாரோடு பொருந்தி வாழ்வதே சிறந்த மதிநுட்பமாகும். மகிழ்ச்சியால் விரிவதும் துன்பத்தால் சுருங்குவதும் இல்லாத மனநிலையே உண்மையான அறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines two aspects of the intellect: practical wisdom and true knowledge. Wisdom (ஒட்பம்) is the ability to embrace the world, meaning to adapt and live in harmony with others. Knowledge (அறிவு) is described through the metaphor of a flower that neither blooms nor closes. This signifies a state of equanimity, where the mind neither expands with pride and joy nor shrinks with fear and sorrow.
